title: Force-Directed Layouts
description: Lays out dependency graphs with force-directed simulation: springs pull related modules together, repulsion spreads them. Clusters emerge visually; the layout is the analysis. It is the default for a reason.

demo.title: Demo — Force-Directed Layouts

title: Dependency Matrices
description: Shows dependencies as adjacency matrices where cell darkness marks coupling. Matrices scale better than node-link for dense graphs; patterns like layers pop out. Architects read them at a glance.

demo.title: Demo — Dependency Matrices

title: Module Constellations
description: Renders modules as star constellations with brightness for importance. The metaphor makes architecture memorable; teams talk about 'the bright cluster'. It aids discussion more than analysis.

demo.title: Demo — Module Constellations

title: Interactive Filtering
description: Filters the constellation interactively: by layer, by team, by change frequency. Sliders and search prune the noise; focus follows the question. Exploration beats static pictures.

demo.title: Demo — Interactive Filtering

title: Impact Analysis
description: Computes the blast radius of a change by walking dependents transitively. Before editing, developers see everything affected; the map prevents surprise breakage. It is the most practical graph query.

demo.title: Demo — Impact Analysis

title: Cycle Detection
description: Finds dependency cycles that defeat layering and complicate builds. Strongly connected components reveal the tangles; breaking them simplifies everything. Zero cycles is the goal.

demo.title: Demo — Cycle Detection

title: 3D Graph Rendering
description: Renders huge dependency graphs in 3D with GPU acceleration. Thousands of nodes stay interactive; rotation disentangles what 2D flattens. It scales where 2D fails.

demo.title: Demo — 3D Graph Rendering

title: Graph Database Storage
description: Stores dependency data in graph databases for rich querying. Cypher finds patterns SQL cannot express; the visualization reads from live queries. It unifies storage and exploration.

demo.title: Demo — Graph Database Storage

title: Incremental Layout
description: Updates layouts incrementally as code changes instead of recomputing. Mental maps persist across commits; only changed regions move. Stability aids comprehension.

demo.title: Demo — Incremental Layout

title: Large-Graph Sampling
description: Samples massive graphs to representative subsets for interactive exploration. Smart sampling preserves structure; the full graph stays in the database. It makes millions of nodes explorable.

demo.title: Demo — Large-Graph Sampling

title: SBOM Integration
description: Overlays SBOM data on the constellation: known vulnerabilities glow. Dependency maps meet security data; risky libraries stand out visually. It turns inventory into insight.

demo.title: Demo — SBOM Integration

title: License Risk Overlay
description: Colors dependencies by license risk: green permissive, red copyleft. Legal review becomes visual; problematic licenses cannot hide. It prevents license surprises.

demo.title: Demo — License Risk Overlay

title: Version Drift Tracking
description: Tracks version drift across the constellation: who lags, who leads. Stale dependencies accumulate risk; the map shows where. Updates get prioritized visually.

demo.title: Demo — Version Drift Tracking

title: CI Integration
description: Fails CI when the constellation violates architecture rules: new cycles, forbidden dependencies. The map becomes a gate; architecture stays clean by construction. It automates the architect.

demo.title: Demo — CI Integration

title: Export Formats
description: Exports constellations to standard formats: GraphML, DOT, JSON. Data escapes the tool into reports, docs, and other analyzers. Open formats prevent lock-in.

demo.title: Demo — Export Formats
